mg.engine.blurb: Lower the engine into the bay, then tighten both mount bolts.

mg.engine.hint.dragSlot: Hold and align with the bay
mg.engine.hint.leftOk: Left done - twist the right bolt
mg.engine.hint.seated: Grab the left mount bolt and twist counter-clockwise
